finalText:
```诊断
Root Cause(s): 
- Readiness probe misconfiguration in deployment/c062-app
  - Probe path "http://:8080/missing-healthz" does not exist
  - Application serves "ok" at root path /index.html

Evidence:
1. Pod status shows 0/1 READY with readiness probe failure events
2. Deployment specifies readinessProbe.httpGet.path: /missing-healthz
3. Container command creates /www/index.html but no /missing-healthz endpoint

Impact/Scope:
- Single pod in siclaw-eval-yye-20260602 namespace
- Affects service/c062-svc availability for 16h+

Confidence: High (95%)

Safe Remediation:
1. Update deployment/c062-app readinessProbe path to match actual endpoint:
```yaml
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /index.html
    port: 8080
```
2. Apply the fix via kubectl set probe deployment/c062-app -n siclaw-eval-yye-20260602
```
